dashboards.name: Serena Launch · website traffic
dashboards.description: Website page views, browser candidates, sessions and acquisition for serenatan.org and Launch. Known automation, test events and marked internal people are excluded from product cards. A browser ID is not a verified human. New page-view coverage starts at release.

insights.name: Website · PV, browsers and sessions

source.query: SELECT count() AS page_views, uniqExact(distinct_id) AS browsers, uniqExact(properties.session_id) AS sessions, uniqExactIf(distinct_id, properties.visitor_type = 'new') AS new_browsers, uniqExactIf(distinct_id, properties.visitor_type = 'returning') AS returning_browsers FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'serena-launch' AND properties.is_test = false AND coalesce(person.properties.$internal_or_test_user, false) = false AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND event = 'page_viewed' AND properties.traffic_type = 'browser'

insights.description: Home and Launch pages, last 30 days. Browser identifiers are not verified people; storage clearing/devices affect counts. Sessions expire after 30 minutes inactivity. New/returning categories may overlap during the period.

insights.name: Website · daily page views and browsers
insights.description: Daily browser candidates after known automation, internal accounts and test events are excluded. Not a guarantee that all sophisticated bots are removed. New event coverage starts at this release; no backfilled history.

insights.name: Website · pages

source.query: SELECT properties.page AS page, count() AS page_views, uniqExact(distinct_id) AS browsers, uniqExact(properties.session_id) AS sessions FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'serena-launch' AND properties.is_test = false AND coalesce(person.properties.$internal_or_test_user, false) = false AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND event = 'page_viewed' AND properties.traffic_type = 'browser' GROUP BY page ORDER BY page_views DESC

insights.description: Separate portfolio homepage / and Launch /launchvideo/. Private consent/settings routes and asset requests are not page views.

insights.name: Website · session acquisition

source.query: SELECT acquisition, count() AS sessions, uniqExact(browser) AS browsers FROM (SELECT properties.session_id AS session, any(distinct_id) AS browser, argMin(coalesce(nullIf(properties.utm_source, ''), nullIf(properties.referrer_host, ''), 'Direct'), timestamp) AS acquisition FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'serena-launch' AND properties.is_test = false AND coalesce(person.properties.$internal_or_test_user, false) = false AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND event = 'page_viewed' AND properties.traffic_type = 'browser' GROUP BY session) GROUP BY acquisition ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 30

insights.description: UTM source or referrer hostname from the first observed page view in each session; otherwise Direct. Query strings and referrer paths are not collected.

insights.name: Website · campaigns

source.query: SELECT properties.utm_source AS source, properties.utm_medium AS medium, properties.utm_campaign AS campaign, uniqExact(properties.session_id) AS sessions, uniqExact(distinct_id) AS browsers FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'serena-launch' AND properties.is_test = false AND coalesce(person.properties.$internal_or_test_user, false) = false AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND event = 'page_viewed' AND properties.traffic_type = 'browser' AND notEmpty(properties.utm_source) GROUP BY source,medium,campaign ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 30

insights.description: Allowlisted UTM labels only. Missing campaigns are not inferred.

insights.name: Website · known automation, kept separate
insights.description: webdriver and recognized crawler/headless user agents. No raw user-agent string or IP is stored by this instrumentation. Bots that never run JavaScript require Cloudflare request analytics.

insights.name: Website · traffic measurement audit

source.query: SELECT properties.traffic_type AS traffic_type, properties.is_test AS is_test, count() AS page_views FROM events WHERE properties.app='serena-launch' AND event='page_viewed' AND timestamp >= now()-INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY traffic_type,is_test ORDER BY page_views DESC

insights.description: Diagnostic intentionally includes QA to prove the production exclusion. Use the other website cards for product traffic.

dashboards.name: Serena Launch · MCP traffic
dashboards.description: Separate HTTP ingress from tool executions, verified active accounts and activation. Excludes test events and marked internal accounts. PostHog is best effort; compare all HTTP requests with Cloudflare Worker Metrics.

insights.name: MCP · HTTP request status

source.query: SELECT properties.status_code AS status, properties.http_method AS method, properties.authenticated AS authenticated, count() AS requests, round(avg(properties.duration_ms),1) AS average_response_ms FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'serena-launch' AND properties.is_test = false AND coalesce(person.properties.$internal_or_test_user, false) = false AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND event='mcp_request_completed' GROUP BY status,method,authenticated ORDER BY requests DESC

insights.description: HTTP ingress including OPTIONS, authorization challenges (401), rate limits (429) and server errors. A 401 challenge can be a normal OAuth discovery step. HTTP 200 does not imply tool success. Time is to response headers, not entire streamed body.

insights.name: MCP · daily HTTP requests and tool calls
insights.description: Requests and executed tools are different volumes: initialize, tools/list and HTTP transport requests are not tool usage. Best-effort PostHog ingestion; Cloudflare Worker Metrics is the infrastructure source for all requests.

insights.name: MCP · active accounts and successful reference users

source.query: SELECT uniqExact(distinct_id) AS accounts_using_tools, count() AS tool_calls, countIf(properties.outcome='error') AS tool_errors, uniqExactIf(distinct_id, properties.tool='get_launch_video' AND properties.reference_found=true AND properties.outcome='success') AS activated_accounts FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'serena-launch' AND properties.is_test = false AND coalesce(person.properties.$internal_or_test_user, false) = false AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND event='mcp_tool_completed'

insights.description: Only accounts from verified OAuth tokens. Browser visitors and service:mcp transport events are never counted as accounts. Activation means retrieving an existing reference, not rendering a finished video.

insights.name: MCP · verified clients
insights.description: Attribution comes from the verified OAuth client, never a caller-supplied runtime label. Codex metadata is recognized; some runtimes share the same client ID and unknown clients stay other.

insights.name: MCP · tool use and errors

source.query: SELECT properties.tool AS tool, count() AS calls, uniqExact(distinct_id) AS accounts, countIf(properties.outcome='error') AS errors, countIf(properties.tool='search_launch_videos' AND properties.result_count=0) AS zero_result_searches, round(avg(properties.duration_ms),1) AS average_ms FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'serena-launch' AND properties.is_test = false AND coalesce(person.properties.$internal_or_test_user, false) = false AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND event='mcp_tool_completed' GROUP BY tool ORDER BY calls DESC

insights.description: Tools, accounts, zero-result searches and tool failures. No tool arguments, product prompts or query text are stored.

insights.name: MCP · most retrieved references

source.query: SELECT properties.reference_id AS reference, count() AS retrievals, uniqExact(distinct_id) AS accounts FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'serena-launch' AND properties.is_test = false AND coalesce(person.properties.$internal_or_test_user, false) = false AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND event='mcp_tool_completed' AND properties.tool='get_launch_video' AND properties.reference_found=true AND properties.outcome='success' GROUP BY reference ORDER BY retrievals DESC LIMIT 50

insights.description: Reference IDs map to https://serenatan.org/launchvideo/#video-ID. Retrieval is not proof the reference was selected for a final video.

insights.name: MCP · protocol requests

source.query: SELECT properties.rpc_method AS rpc_method, count() AS requests FROM events WHERE properties.app = 'serena-launch' AND properties.is_test = false AND coalesce(person.properties.$internal_or_test_user, false) = false AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND event='mcp_request_completed' AND properties.authenticated=true GROUP BY rpc_method ORDER BY requests DESC

insights.description: Allowlisted JSON-RPC method names only, from size-validated request bodies. No arguments, credentials, full URLs or caller-supplied account IDs.
